title: Motion (Jurado - Hernandez) relative to instructions to the Bureau of Sanitation to: suspend CARE+ operations in areas impacted by environmental emergencies…
text:
[Council File 26-0936]
Motion (Jurado - Hernandez) relative to instructions to the Bureau of Sanitation to: suspend CARE+ operations in areas impacted by environmental emergencies as declared by the City or State; implement a posting protocol for any environmental emergencies suspension of homeless encampment cleanups; and related matters.
(Referred to Housing and Homelessness Committee and Energy and Environment Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Instructions to the Bureau of Sanitation to suspend CARE+ operations in areas impacted by environmental emergencies and implement a posting protocol for suspension of homeless encampment cleanups.

outcome.text: Ad Hoc Committee for Boyle Heights Fire Recovery approved item(s) (Sep 18, 2026)
